title: Megurine Luka — Happy Anniversary! 2025〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Whew... Another day, another exciting show.
Oh, there you are, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Everyone...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Nice work with your special anniversary concert!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It was suuuper cool! And the audience was really energized!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. We had a wonderful view of them creating a sea of light from over in the wings.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's right. Thank you again for inviting us, Luka. We really enjoyed watching from backstage.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The show was jam-packed with everything that people love about you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Cutesy classic idol hits to cool dance tracks, playful banter between songs...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And most importantly, so much interaction with your fans! They couldn't get enough of it!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you all enjoyed yourselves.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Especially since I went to you for advice so many times while I was putting the show together.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I wanted to give you all an experience that would express my gratitude... Did that come across?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It diiid!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I think Minori might still be in concert-goer mode.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But still... I liked that every section of the show felt like a reflection of Luka's personality.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Especially the medley where Luka sang a duet with each of us. I didn't expect the crowd to go so wild for that!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: If I recall correctly, that segment was Minori's idea.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehehe. I figured that Luka should have the most fun today since it is her anniversary.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: She was saying that she wanted a lot of opportunities to sing with everyone, which had me thinking. What about a medley where she sang with each person at a time?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Not to mention... We'd also get to see some rare combinations, and how cool would that be?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You started off so strong there...and then it turned into your fangirl fantasy.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I have to admit though, I did really enjoy seeing those less-seen pair-ups.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe, I'm glad to hear it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We also had fun being up on stage with you for your special day.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! We put all our effort into expressing our anniversary wishes with the show. Although...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I kinda feel bad that we enjoyed your performance the most, even though we're the ones celebrating you...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know what you mean. Luka's always charming, but today she was overflowing with idol charisma.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A strong and confident persona for the cool songs, full of warm smiles for the cute songs... I'm amazed how she could effortlessly blend into each song like a chameleon.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: If I could, then it was thanks to each of my duet partners.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: All of your hopes and feelings shone through, which I think pushed my performance to the next level.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, once again, thank you all for today.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Luka...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It was our pleasure to be of service.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. You were having such a good time singing, and the feeling was infectious!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I appreciate the kind words.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But...one moment in the concert stands out above all else...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Right at the end, when Luka blew those knockout kisses to the audience!

rows.Speaker: Minori & Rin
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
And not just the audience...
I was so shocked when she blew some to us in the wings!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Me too! A barrage of kisses from an idol at point-blank range... I thought I was gonna pass out!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. All the while, I was enjoying everyone's different reactions♪ Joy, embarrassment, surprise...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hahaha... Of course you were, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But, you really were enjoying yourself more than ever!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Not just the kisses...
The sharpness of your movements, the way you held the long notes... It was perfect from start to finish!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I suppose it's to be expected for an anniversary concert? It is a special day after all.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, partly that. But also...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I think I was so energized today thanks to the performance I watched beforehand.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Do you mean...the anniversary show for our world's Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Exactly. Remember how you girls showed me a little of it? The Luka in your world also had many fans show up to her anniversary show.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Thank you all again so much for coming to my special anniversary concert!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Now we've reached the second half of today's show... It's time for a little game titled:

rows.Speaker: Miku & Len
rows.Line: “Look Into Luka's Mind! Set List Predictions♪”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We have to try and predict the next two songs on Luka's set list. Can you guys guess?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: By the way, this game was Luka's idea! Right Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That's right.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I'm here today because of so many emotions...
Those that went into each song, and those felt by the people listening to them.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I chose songs that I wanted everyone to hear as my way of expressing gratitude for that.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So I hope that they're also songs that everyone wants to hear.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Well then, everyone watching in the audience and on the livestream, start predicting!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Seeing that version of me having fun motivated me to enjoy my anniversary just as much.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And...it also inspired me to give you all a show to remember.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That's why I was more energized than usual.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Luka...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I guess that means the concert was a huge success.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. Both you and your audience were having the time of your lives. It was an unforgettable show.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Really? I honestly was having so much fun, so I'm happy you feel that way.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But, it's too early to pack up and go home!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Don't forget, it is your anniversary. We want to make it a day to remember for you too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And so, get ready for...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Luka's Special Anniversary Show, performed by MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: A special show?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We'll also be helping out behind the scenes♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okie dokie, leave the sound to me!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And you can count on us to provide excellent lighting!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, Luka, take a seat here in the VIP section.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: All of you...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (They must have all done so much preparation for me...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (I was happy enough for them just to participate in my concert, but they put this together too...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (I was just thinking how this has been a lovely anniversary with everyone celebrating with me, but...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It seems the celebrations are just getting started.
